Ivy (Partnerships): Heads-up — Aurora Schools is live on EduHub and signed a 12mo paid plan. Listing went public this morning: https://eduhub.market/aurora-schools :tada:
Marco (AE): PO received and processed. They added the "AutoGrade" add-on. Big lift from the demo last month.
Sana (Customer Success): Onboarding checklist started. Verified SSO and roster sync. Found one small gap: LTI launch returns 403 for older SIS versions — sending repro to @Dev.
Dev (Solutions): Thanks — reproduced and pushed a hotfix to staging. Patch: set `ALLOW_LEGACY_SIS=true` for legacy tenants. Will follow up with a doc snippet.
contracts-bot: Contracts: marketplace addendum signed and recorded. No outstanding approvals.
marketplace-bot: Listing update: draft -> published. Live URL: https://eduhub.market/aurora-schools (published 08:40 UTC).
Pri (Marketing): Love it. Can we get a 1-2 sentence quote and a screenshot of the AutoGrade view for a short case study this week?
Marco (AE): Reached out to their VP of Ops — they provided: "AutoGrade cut grading time in half and helped teachers focus on feedback." Sending to @Pri now.
Sana (Customer Success): Uploaded onboarding guide and demo screenshot: https://redwood-internal/playbooks/aurora-onboard.md. Note to CS: enable short demo tokens (TTL=2h) for workshops.
Ivy (Partnerships): I'll schedule a co-marketing call for next Tue. Adding Asana task: "Aurora case study + marketplace card" and assigning @Pri, @Sana, @Dev. Great work team! :rocket:
